items.name: Chelish Captain's Saber
items.description: The Chelish Captain's Saber is a finely crafted longsword with a hilt boasting intricate designs inspired by Cheliax's heraldry. Each blade is emblazoned with the insignia of the Chelish Navy, representing both authority and duty. These sabers are bestowed upon captains who have proven themselves in maritime operations, serving as both a badge of office and a weapon ready for both deadly skirmishes and ceremonial displays.

items.name: +1 Mithral Chain Shirt
items.description:
Covering the torso, this shirt is made up of thousands of interlocking metal rings.
Mithral

Mithral is a rare, silvery metal that is lighter than steel but just as hard. When worked like steel, it can be used to create amazing armor, and is occasionally used for other items as well. Most mithral armors are one category lighter than normal for purposes of movement and other limitations. items.name: Seaclaw
items.description:
Forged in the clandestine forges beneath Goatshead’s rust-crusted taverns, Seaclaw is a weathered but lethal six-shooter once belonging to the pirate captain Bent-Beak Charney. Its dark steel barrel is engraved with curling sea-wind motifs, and its walnut grip bears an inlaid brass skull-and-crossbones. The hammer falls with the sound of a distant thunderclap, said to echo the pirate’s own curse.
Aura: moderate evocation
Caster Level: 9
Requirements: Craft Magic Arms and Armor, flame arrow

items.description:
Chapter 7: Encumbered Hearts

items.name: Cloak of Resistance +1
items.description:
This garment offers magic protection in the form of a +1 to +5 resistance bonus on all saving throws (Fortitude, Reflex, and Will).
ConstructionRequirements Craft Wondrous Item, resistance, creator's caster level must be at least three times the cloak's bonus; Cost 500 gp

items.name: Ring of Protection +1
items.description:
This ring offers continual magical protection in the form of a deflection bonus of +1 to +5 to AC.
ConstructionRequirements Forge Ring, shield of faith, caster must be of a level at least three times higher than the bonus of the ring; Cost 1,000 gp
